summary: Animate Unity objects from an Inspector dropdown or fluent DOTween API, with 300 presets, custom extensions, optional recipes and previews.
description:
DOTween Free is required and installed separately. Tween Helper requires DOTween runtime 1.3.030 or newer and Unity UI/TextMesh Pro. Import TMP Essential Resources before opening the Animation Gallery. DOTween is developed by Demigiant and is not included with Tween Helper.

Choose an animation on your GameObject
Add Tween Player, select a category and animation, then preview it or enable Play On Start. Animate the same GameObject or assign another target, adjust duration, and use the settings available for each preset. A single preset does not require a recipe asset.

Compose reusable motion
Use the fluent C# API to combine sequential and simultaneous animation steps for transforms, UI, sprites, TextMesh Pro, collections, progress values, gameplay feedback, cameras, audio, lights, particles and material properties. Control playback, rewind, callbacks, asynchronous completion and cancellation through TweenHandle. Optional Tween Recipes provide reusable sequences with multiple targets and automatically synchronized bindings.

Build everyday game and UI effects
• UI entrances, exits, hover, press and attention feedback.
• List and grid staggering, card dealing and layout transitions.
• Arc, Bezier, Hop, Spring, waypoint paths and world-to-UI pickup motion.
• Damage, reward, healing, cooldown and progression feedback.
• Toasts, modals, tooltips, dropdowns, tabs, drawers and page transitions.
• TMP character, word and line animation, animated numbers and text restoration.
• Progress bars, camera feedback and animated audio, light, particle and material properties.

Explore and extend
Start with 300 built-in presets. The Preset Browser provides isolated previews, filters, favorites, recent entries and C# examples. The Animation Gallery includes 423 built-in entries plus the included custom example and supports legacy input or the Input System. Component examples, seven recipe samples, a progress/reward prefab and documentation show how to adapt the package to your project. Register your own presets to make them available in the Inspector and Browser.

Guided setup
The Setup window opens once per package version and checks dependencies and text resources. Its buttons open the official installation and setup tools. Gallery and Browser launch buttons become available when setup is complete. Reopen it from Tools > Tween Helper > Setup.

Compatibility and customization
Developed with Unity 6.6 (6000.6.0f1) for Built-in Render Pipeline and URP. Other Unity versions, HDRP and custom render pipelines have not been tested. Player-build compatibility for this release has not been verified.

Your project's DOTween configuration is preserved by default. Reduced-motion options apply to supported strength-aware effects; custom effects may need their own implementation. Custom Editor previews require opt-in to the supported state-restoration behavior. Register or preserve custom presets when using managed code stripping. Tween Helper runs locally and requires no online service at runtime.
technicalDetails:
Version: 1.3.0-rc.6
Unity Editor: 6.6 (6000.6.0f1)
Render pipelines: Built-in and URP; HDRP and custom pipelines have not been tested.
Other Unity versions and player-build compatibility for this release have not been verified.

Dependencies
• DOTween Free runtime 1.3.030 or newer, installed and licensed separately. Complete the normal DOTween setup, including its Editor tools and module loader. Optional UI/Sprite extensions are not required.
• Unity UI 2.6.0 (com.unity.ugui), which includes TextMesh Pro in Unity 6. The archive declares this registry dependency.
• TMP Essential Resources for the Animation Gallery, imported through the official TMP importer.

Included
• 300 built-in registered presets and a custom preset example.
• Preset Browser with 461 built-in entries, custom presets, filters, favorites, recent entries and code examples.
• Animation Gallery with 423 built-in entries plus the included custom example.
• Tween Player component with preset selection, optional external targets, duration overrides and supported preset settings.
• 28 recipe operations and seven recipe samples, direct/custom preset examples and a progress/reward prefab.
• Guided Setup window and installation, quick-start, API, extension, lifecycle, recipe, motion and performance documentation.

C# API
Typed builders and extension methods; sequential and simultaneous steps; supported timing, easing and loops; playback, rewind, completion, callbacks, cancellation and async waiting.

Supported targets
GameObject/Transform, RectTransform, CanvasGroup, UI Graphic/Image/Slider, UI and world-space TMP, SpriteRenderer/Renderer properties, collections, Camera, AudioSource, Light and ParticleSystem.

Namespace: LB.TweenHelper
Installation folder: Assets/Loags/TweenHelper
The package contains editable source code. DOTween and Unity's UI/TMP libraries and resources are separate dependencies, not bundled content.
compatibility: Developed with Unity 6.6 (6000.6.0f1) for Built-in and URP. Requires separately installed DOTween Free runtime 1.3.030+, Unity UI/TextMesh Pro and TMP Essential Resources for the gallery. The Setup window guides installation. Other Unity versions, HDRP, custom pipelines and player-build compatibility for this release have not been verified.

The generated material was integrated into the package's preset, recipe and Editor workflows, revised for consistency, and tested in Unity. Tween Helper does not use AI at runtime.
